surface_restriction.cb_reduction: CB(|D_l|) for Z_red is exactly CB for the conductor-descended subspace H0(C,O_C(D_l)) evaluated on Z_red

factor_line_package.supported_divisor: U=sum of the 112*l supported normalization branches

source_basis: Freitag-Salvati Manni Theorem 2.4: box degree-one coordinates are invariant products of the five one-factor theta coordinates
their five independent holomorphic differentials identify the one-factor theta projective line bundle with K_C8
full G quotient C8->P1 has six order-two branch values, so Riemann-Hurwitz gives K_C8=pi_G^*O(1)

for_each_p_in_R.conclusion: there exists a normalization section vanishing on R_i\{p} but not at p

normalization_CB_test.conclusion: R_i is not Cayley-Bacharach for the full normalization linear system H0(E,nu^*O_C(D_l)) for any l>=1

remaining_gate.statement: surface CB can only arise because the conductor/gluing descent subspace H0(C,O_C(D_l)) excludes every normalization one-point-separating section, possibly together with collisions under nu
